Educational Objectives The Master Program in Business Administration aims to provide solid economics and management analytical training for students; and enable them to be talents with a thorough and professional knowledge in one of the following fields: Enterprise Strategic Management; Marketing Management; Human Resource Management; Operation & Logistics Management; Accounting & Finance Management; Tourism Management; etc. By the training, the students can be competent for the practical work of management, education and research in enterprise & business organizations, government departments, and education & research institutions. 2．Period of Schooling Two and a half years. 3．Research Fields and Tutors 1) Marketing Management 2) Human Resources Management 3) Enterprise Strategic Management 4) Logistics Management 5) Tourism Planning & Development 6) Tourism Corporate Management 7) Accounting 8) Financial Management 4．Curriculum and Credit Requirements 1) Curriculum (Please refer to the following table) 2) Credit Requirements: at least 52 credits 3) In order to elevate academic research capacity, the graduate students are required to give lectures in 3 seminars or 4 class discussions as well as a publicly-issued paper in journals home and abroad during academic years. Proposal 1) Theme The theme of dissertation must be relevant with frontiers or cross-sectional fields concerning national economy in major research 2) Prerequisites Candidates are required to obtain the required credits and submit at least 4000 words literature reading report 3) Requirements Candidates must submit a proposal concerning dissertation within the second semester of the second year after enrollment, including literature review, the meaning of the dissertation, research aim, difficulties and features, would-be innovations, etc. and at least 30 references, of which at least 10 references of foreign researchers. 4) Check and Approval Public presentation must be held to check the proposal by major tutor board (at least 3 including at least 1 professor) The writing of dissertation can be prepared after the pass of the check 5.2. In-progress Report In the course of writing, candidates should submit reports concerning dissertation so as to ensure the dissertation may proceed as schedule. If the spread is large, advice will be given. 5.3. Oral defense of the dissertation 1) Qualifications After dissertation has been firstly checked by the tutor after accomplishment and a paper has been published in core journals, a pre-oral defense can be applied for. 2) Pre-oral defense This defense is held before correspondence and conducted by the major tutor board. If the check is successful, the student could hand the dissertation to correspondence after necessary revision following suggestions of the board, and if failed, a modification or a rewriting is required. 3) Correspondence and Oral Defense Dissertation should be checked by 5 experts in specialty in the form of correspondence(both student and tutor's names are concealed for at least 2 experts) Oral defense can be held with all experts' agreements after the dissertation has been modified following the suggestions of experts. If the oral defense fails, the dissertation should be dealt with according to regulations made by Graduate Department of the University.
